name: 5xx-errors
title: Serve is returning HTTP 5xx errors
description: The load balancer recorded more than one target HTTP 5xx response in a minute.
investigation_steps: Check the load balancer metrics and see what is causing the HTTP 5xx errors.
Review application logs and recent deployments for errors, are the errors ongoing or one-time failures?
Check the service itself, is it experiencing issues or degraded performance? If the issue is affecting users, and incident will most likely need to be raised.
